result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments from the comments list. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `updateComment`, which sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. The `useUpdateComment` hook refetches that discussion's comments after a save. The input is validated with Zod and the body can't be empty.
- **Edit button and drawer:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit" button that opens a form drawer, pre-filled with the current body. After a successful save it shows a "Comment Updated" notification.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that checks `comment.author.id === user.id`. Admins don't get an Edit button on other people's comments. I also split the existing delete check in `comments-list.tsx`, so Edit and Delete are now gated separately.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH /comments/:commentId` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` so it works in dev and tests. It only updates a comment if the logged-in user is its author.

I haven't run Prettier on the new files, so formatting may need a pass.

I didn't add an integration test for the new flow.
